messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] arg_refactor: samples.csv for optimize does not include results
parts:
This is probably mirroring the behaviour on develop where only the final state is saved unless save_warmup is set.  I think flipping the behaviour for optimization makes the most sense, i.e., have save_iterations=1 by default.

Cheers,
Marcus
